purpose: Reject a temporal-code update that gains target utility by causing unacceptable code or general-capability forgetting.

code_guardrail.source: frozen EvalPlus E2 development and untouched confirmatory splits

general_text_guardrail.confidence_rule: one-sided 95% training-seed-level upper confidence bound must not exceed 0.01

forbidden_uses: using retention outcomes in Stage B
changing margins after development or confirmatory outcomes
inspecting confirmatory outcomes before the development decision is frozen
using different Stage-A baselines for sensitivity arms
utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective
claim_boundary: Retention decision contract only; no Utility, release, or curation-benefit claim.
